correctness.rationale: The 8 perfect matchings of octahedral O=K_{2,2,2} are precisely the minimal 3-edge forbidden faces. Each of the 12 octahedral edges lies in exactly 2 matchings; this incidence is the 12 cube Q3 edges. Thus the Alexander-dual cover by complements of the 8 matchings has nerve Ind(Q3)^*, and two integral combinatorial Alexander-duality dimension shifts give H~_i(NM3(O);Z) = H~_(i−4)(Ind(Q3);Z). The independence complex of Q3 consists of two parity tetrahedra joined by four antipodal bridges and hence a wedge of three circles. Nonmatching complex has complete 1-skeleton, and each missing triangle boundary can be coned using any other edge; pi1=0, successive Hurewicz and Whitehead yield wedge^3 S5. Independently constructed all 8 matchings, 12-vertex incidence, enumerated 1699 augmented faces, and an explicit full 4096-subset bijection with M2(Q3) in co-reviewed record5. Compared all 48 B3 action traces after induced cube-group identification, agreeing with signed-coordinate U, no invariant line. The supplied graph checker also specifies full 847-pair acyclic ordinary-face matching and 48 exact Lefschetz tests, but its saved log is not treated as proof.
residual_risks: Homology calculation is integral; character claim is rational, not a canonical integral module extension.
The equivariant comparison with co-reviewed record 5 includes a nontrivial automorphism of B3, so raw character formulas appear different under naive identical parameter labels.

originality.rationale: Balanced complete tripartite K2,2,2 is a natural unresolved multipartite nonmatching-complex case in Linusson–Shareshian–Welker; their complete and complete-bipartite results and Holmsen–Lee homological vanishings do not specify this integral homotopy type plus full B3 character. Shan–Wang edge-addition theorem assumes bipartite graphs and cannot simply apply to octahedron containing triangles. Critical discovered equivalence: the co-reviewed cuboctahedral clique-free record5 is EXACTLY the same 12-vertex simplicial complex under perfect-matching-to-cube-edge incidence, including conjugate B3 action (all 48 traces agree). They are not two independent novel results; this record is treated as the canonical representative of that single result, and record5 as a duplicate, not claimed as historical prior.
residual_risks: A previously unpublished or alternate cube M2 computation can coincide despite unsuccessful database matches.
Full Shan–Wang and Holmsen–Lee texts were not independently exhausted; their clearly stated bipartite and vanishing scopes alone do not directly imply the exact claim.
The two simultaneous assigned records present equivalent theorems; publication must deduplicate rather than claim two independent discoveries.
